name: GSN Inversion
aliases: Inversion of Locally Conditioned Radiance Fields
definition: The process of finding a latent code grid Ŵ that, when passed through a trained locally conditioned radiance field f, reconstructs input source views S and predicts target views T. It solves the problem of generating unseen parts of a scene or editing scenes by optimizing latent codes rather than sampling from the prior.
summary: GSN Inversion optimizes a latent code grid to locally condition a radiance field, using a local coordinate system robust to rotations unlike global methods.
